title: The Banned Experiment That Created a Man Without a Soul
hook: Scientists raised a human clone in complete silence to see if consciousness requires language, and the result was terrifying.
why_this_can_go_viral: The concept of a soulless human taps into deep existential fears and forbidden science lore.

title: The Parasite That Reprograms Its Host's Brain to Seek Death
hook: A microscopic worm forces insects to march into water and drown, all to complete its life cycle.
why_this_can_go_viral: Body horror combined with mind control is inherently viral, especially when it involves real biology.

title: The Fraud Scientist Who Faked a Memory Transplant Between Species
hook: He claimed he could transfer memories from a rat into a fish, and the scientific community believed him for a decade.
why_this_can_go_viral: The audacity of the lie and the gullibility of scientists make for a juicy scandal story.
